senses.definition_en: Don Juan, philanderer, womanizer

examples.english: Mrs. Melville belonged to one of Guatemala's most powerful families, whose fortune was rooted in the cement industry. Her beauty had been as legendary as her unfortunate love life. Her marriage to a wealthy womanizer had broken the record for brevity in the annals of high society. It only took a few days for Martha Jane to file for divorce and annulment, which was processed by none other than Monsignor Gerardi.
examples.ref: 2003, Maite Rico, Bertrand de la Grange, “La pista eclesial”, in ¿Quién mató al obispo? Autopsia de un crimen político, Mexico City: Planeta Mexicana, →OL; republished Mexico City: Planeta Mexicana, 2004, →ISBN, →LCCN, →OL, page 69:
examples.text: La señora Melville pertenecía a una de las familias más poderosas de Guatemala, cuya fortuna hundía sus raíces en la industria del cemento. Su belleza había sido tan legendaria como su infortunada vida sentimental. Su matrimonio con un acaudalado donjuán había batido el récord de brevedad en los anales de la alta sociedad. Apenas bastaron unos días para que Martha Jane pidiera el divorcio y la nulidad, que fue tramitada precisamente por monseñor Gerardi.
examples.translation: Mrs. Melville belonged to one of Guatemala's most powerful families, whose fortune was rooted in the cement industry. Her beauty had been as legendary as her unfortunate love life. Her marriage to a wealthy womanizer had broken the record for brevity in the annals of high society. It only took a few days for Martha Jane to file for divorce and annulment, which was processed by none other than Monsignor Gerardi.

glosses: Don Juan, philanderer, womanizer
